brokers.name: TruePeopleSearch
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA data broker registry as 'Free Data Services, LLC' DBA TruePeopleSearch.com (confirmed via the live registry.csv download from cppa.ca.gov, checked 2026-07-10). Independent from FastPeopleSearch's registrant despite similar branding and UX — see notes.
brokers.notes: Removal page at truepeoplesearch.com/removal: search by name+city+state, open the listing, click 'Remove This Record', confirm via emailed link. A 2024 Krebs on Security piece raised suspicion that TruePeopleSearch and FastPeopleSearch share a common (possibly China-based, possibly fabricated-identity) operator, but the CA CPPA registry lists them under two different legal registrants ('Free Data Services, LLC' vs. 'Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC') — used the registry as the authoritative source over the speculative blog post, so parent_id is left null here. Phone opt-out alternative also offered: (888) 838-4803. Reappearance after public-record refreshes is common and well documented across multiple removal guides.

brokers.name: FastPeopleSearch
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as a DBA of 'Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC', which also operates CyberBackgroundChecks, AdvancedBackgroundChecks, SearchPeopleFree, and USPhoneBook (all in this batch) plus FastBackgroundCheck.com, PeopleSearchNow.com, Phonebooks.com, SmartBackgroundChecks.com, and USA-People-Search.com (not yet catalogued). Confirmed via registry.csv download from cppa.ca.gov, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Removal form at fastpeoplesearch.com/removal requires an ownership-affirmation checkbox, reCAPTCHA, name/city/state search, and a 'Remove My Record' click, followed by email confirmation. Multiple removal guides note FastPeopleSearch is inconsistent about honoring opt-outs from residents of states without a comprehensive privacy law — worth flagging to the user if they are not in a state with a private right/AG-enforced deletion right.

brokers.name: SearchPeopleFree
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as a DBA of 'Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC' — see fastpeoplesearch entry for the full sibling-brand list. Confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Opt-out page at searchpeoplefree.com/opt-out: submit email + name + CAPTCHA, then click an emailed link to reach the actual removal form, fill in matching listing details, and submit. Site states a ~72 hour SLA for processing.

brokers.name: USPhoneBook
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as a DBA of 'Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC' — see fastpeoplesearch entry for the full sibling-brand list. Confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Removal page at usphonebook.com/removal (also linked from the footer 'do not sell my personal information'): name + email + CAPTCHA, then confirm via a 24-hour-expiring emailed link. Phone alternative also offered: (888) 747-4095. Guides consistently flag this operator's sibling sites (see mississippi-tornado-alley group) as high-reappearance because they re-scrape public records on a rolling basis.

brokers.name: ThatsThem
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as a DBA of 'Spokeo, Inc.' alongside Anywho.com, Freepeopledirectory.com, Peoplewin.com, and Family.me — confirmed via registry.csv download from cppa.ca.gov, checked 2026-07-10. This directly contradicts several third-party opt-out guides that describe AnyWho as an Intelius/PeopleConnect property; the CPPA self-report is treated as authoritative here.
brokers.notes: Opt-out form at thatsthem.com/optout requires the exact name/address/phone as shown on the listing plus a CAPTCHA solve, and a confirmation email/link. Each distinct listing (e.g. from a past address) needs its own separate submission. No single opt-out is documented that also covers sibling Spokeo brands — unlike PeopleConnect's centralized flow, each Spokeo-owned brand currently appears to need its own opt-out filed separately (see the 'spokeo' owner_group notes).

brokers.name: PeekYou
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: PeekYou LLC has a legacy registration under the old pre-2024 CA AG data broker list (oag.ca.gov registration #550652), but does NOT appear in the current CPPA registry.csv download (checked 2026-07-10, searched for 'peekyou' and variants — no match). Treated as not currently CA-registered under the Delete Act regime; flag to the user that CA DROP will not cover this broker.
brokers.notes: Multiple 2026 guides report the older https://www.peekyou.com/about/contact/optout/ path now 404s and that the correct current form is at .../about/contact/ccpa_optout/do_not_sell/ — flagged by a Privacy Guides community thread as a link that has moved before, so re-verify live before relying on it in production. Form requires the profile URL, name, a reachable email, and a CAPTCHA solve, plus confirming three declaration checkboxes.

brokers.name: ClustrMaps
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Not found in the current CPPA registry.csv download (checked 2026-07-10, searched for 'clustrmaps' and variants — no match). ClustrMaps Ltd is UK-registered (Milton Keynes); no evidence found that it has registered as a CA data broker, so CA DROP will not cover it.
brokers.notes: Guides cite clustrmaps.com/opt-out as the removal form: enter name, email, listing URL and address, check the data fields to remove, submit, then confirm via an emailed verification link. Live fetch of this URL to confirm current form fields was blocked in this research pass (network fetch failed) — treat the URL as guide-cited but not independently re-verified today. CAPTCHA presence was not clearly documented in the sources reviewed; treat as possible, not confirmed. Site continuously re-scrapes, so reappearance is common per removal guides.

brokers.name: Nuwber
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as 'Nuwber Inc' — confirmed via registry.csv download from cppa.ca.gov, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Official and only removal path is nuwber.com/removal/link: paste the listing URL, submit an email address, and confirm via the emailed link. Nuwber explicitly states it does not accept opt-out requests by phone or email outside this flow. No CAPTCHA was mentioned in the sources reviewed; support contact (support@nuwber.com per help center) is available if data reappears.

brokers.name: CheckPeople
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as 'CHECKPEOPLE, LLC' with no DBA listed — confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Dedicated removal portal at checkpeople.com/opt-out (also linked from the footer 'do not sell or share my personal information'): find the matching profile, enter name and email, complete CAPTCHA, confirm via emailed link. Guides report roughly a 5-7 day processing window. Removing a CheckPeople listing does not affect the underlying public records it was built from.

brokers.name: AdvancedBackgroundChecks
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as a DBA of 'Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC' — see fastpeoplesearch entry for the full sibling-brand list. Confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Removal at advancedbackgroundchecks.com/removal: enter email + CAPTCHA to begin, then submit name/email/listing URL, select and remove the record, then confirm via emailed verification link. Site also publishes a formal CCPA 'Notice of Right to Opt-Out' page (/do-not-sell). Guides recommend rechecking every 3-6 months for reappearance.

brokers.name: CyberBackgroundChecks
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as a DBA of 'Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC' — see fastpeoplesearch entry for the full sibling-brand list. Confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Two-step removal at cyberbackgroundchecks.com/removal: first submit name + email + CAPTCHA and click the emailed link (valid 24 hours), then a second 'Record Suppression Form' asks for middle name/phone (optional) plus another CAPTCHA. Users with common names may need to repeat for multiple listings.

brokers.name: FamilyTreeNow
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as 'Family Tree Now, LLC' with no DBA listed — confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Opt-out at familytreenow.com/optout: search by first/last name + state, select the record, click Opt Out, solve the CAPTCHA, submit, then confirm via an emailed link. No account or email is required just to locate and flag a record for removal (email is only needed to confirm). Genealogy-sourced, so opting out removes only the named person's record, not listed relatives/associates — each family member must opt out separately.

brokers.name: AnyWho
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as a DBA of 'Spokeo, Inc.' (confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10) alongside ThatsThem — NOT an Intelius/PeopleConnect property, despite that being the commonly repeated claim in third-party opt-out guides (likely stale from an earlier ownership arrangement or simple guide error). parent_id set to 'spokeo', not 'peopleconnect', on the strength of the CPPA self-report.
brokers.notes: No dedicated, independently-confirmed AnyWho-branded opt-out form was found; one guide cites https://www.anywho.com/help/privacy as an AnyWho-specific privacy/help page, but given AnyWho is a Spokeo DBA per the CPPA filing, Spokeo's own opt-out tool at spokeo.com/optout (used elsewhere in this registry for the 'spokeo' broker entry) is the more reliably documented removal path and is used here. Re-verify the live AnyWho footer link before relying on this in production — this is the least-certain opt_out_url in this batch.

brokers.name: SpyDialer
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as 'Spy Labs AdCo, LLC' DBA Spydialer.com — confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Consumer removal flow at spydialer.com/consumers/: select state, solve CAPTCHA, continue past the privacy-law notice, enter the phone number/data to opt out, and submit. Name + landline number is generally enough to make the reverse-lookup unusable. A separate business-listing removal path exists for business numbers (not used here). Guides recommend rechecking every 3-6 months.

brokers.name: PeopleFinder.com
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: peoplefinder.com (singular — distinct from the separately-owned peoplefinders.com/'PeopleFinders') is registered with the CPPA as one of dozens of Intelius, LLC DBA domains (confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10), and Intelius, LLC is itself a documented PeopleConnect, Inc. subsidiary. parent_id set to 'peopleconnect' to match the existing owner_groups.peopleconnect entry in the base registry (which already lists 'intelius' as a member) — NOTE FOR MERGE: this fragment does not add 'peoplefinder' to owner_groups.peopleconnect.members to avoid clobbering that group definition in a parallel fragment; whoever merges batches should add it (and confirm whether an 'intelius' broker entry from another batch already covers this).
brokers.notes: peoplefinder.com itself has no independent, separately-branded opt-out form documented in the sources reviewed; it is opted out via its actual operator, Intelius, at intelius.com/optout (or by emailing priorityoptout@intelius.com / calling (888) 245-1655 per Intelius's own CA registry filing). Do not confuse with 'PeopleFinders' (peoplefinders.com, plural), a separately-registered CA data broker ('Peoplefinders, LLC') not covered by this entry.

brokers.name: GoLookUp
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No matching entity found in the current CPPA registry.csv download searched for 'golookup' and variants (checked 2026-07-10) — treated as not CA-registered, so CA DROP will not cover it. No distinct legal-entity name (LLC/Inc) for GoLookUp was confirmed in the sources reviewed; 'owner' is left as the brand name pending better documentation.
brokers.notes: Opt-out form at golookup.com/support/optout (also linked from the homepage footer): enter name, email, phone, address, and date of birth, select 'Delete My Information' as request type, complete CAPTCHA, submit. Collects more identifying fields (DOB) in the removal form itself than most peers in this batch — apply minimum-PII discipline and only supply what the form strictly requires. Guides cite a ~7 day processing window.

spokeo.notes: Confirmed via Spokeo, Inc.'s CA CPPA data broker registry filing (registry.csv, checked 2026-07-10), which lists Spokeo.com, Freepeopledirectory.com, Thatsthem.com, Peoplewin.com, Anywho.com, and Family.me as DBAs of the same registrant. The base registry's existing 'spokeo' broker entry (id: spokeo, parent_id: null) is left untouched by this fragment — it predates this discovery and is not redefined here since only batch-a.json is in scope. Unlike PeopleConnect, no single centralized opt-out tool spanning all these brands is documented; each brand's own form currently must be filed separately.

mississippi-tornado-alley.notes: Confirmed via this operator's CA CPPA data broker registry filing (registry.csv, checked 2026-07-10), which lists CyberBackgroundChecks.com, AdvancedBackgroundChecks.com, FastBackgroundCheck.com, PeopleSearchNow.com, Phonebooks.com, SearchPeopleFree.com, SmartBackgroundChecks.com, USA-People-Search.com, USPhoneBook.com, and FastPeopleSearch.com as DBAs of the same LLC. Only the five domains catalogued in this batch are listed as members; FastBackgroundCheck.com, PeopleSearchNow.com, Phonebooks.com, SmartBackgroundChecks.com, and USA-People-Search.com are not yet catalogued as broker entries anywhere in the registry. No single centralized opt-out tool spanning these brands is documented; each site's own removal form must be filed separately.
